  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "Julian pulses are cooked thus: Soak {{ing_01|well-cleaned spelt}}, put it on the fire; when cooked, add {{ing_02|oil}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "If it threatens to become thick, carefully thin it down."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "Take {{ing_03|two cooked brains}} and {{ing_04|1/2 pound of meat ground as for forcemeat}}, crush this with the {{ing_03|brains}} and put in a pot."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "Crush {{ing_05|pepper}}, {{ing_06|lovage}} and {{ing_07|fennel seed}}, moistened with {{ing_08|broth}}, {{ing_09|a little wine}} and put it on top of the {{ing_03|brain}} and {{ing_04|meat}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "When this forcemeat is heated sufficiently, mix it with the {{ing_01|spelt}} [finish boiling] transfer into service dish, thinned."
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "text": "This must have the consistency of a heavy juice [4]."
    }
  ],
